At the entrance to the port, one of Rahat's goons spots a lone figure moping around nearby.

"Ay, brother!"

The figure ignores the goon's calls.

"Ay, you better get out of here before I smoke your ass! Go on, get!"

The figure looks up and at the goon. Before he can even react, the goon gets shot in the head by the figure.

Once the corpse slumps to the ground, the figure begins to run towards the port's gates, calling out to his buddies in the shadows to follow suit. It'll take them 10 minutes before they arrive to the location where the deal is going down.[/quote]
[b]"What the fvck. MOVE NOW."[/b]

The cigarette in his hand flew to the ground as he pulled back, [b]"B4L get over here!"[/b] He waves them over, pulling back to the ship. Or however far he can get before they arrive.

[b]"Brothers, formation!"[/b] All members of the Dharic family took defensive positions and expected the B4L soldiers to fall in with them.

They prepared for the foreign assault and readied themselves mentally for a counteroffensive.

[quote=yzakastan;61355349]The shah looked at the president and then stated, Ah, no, no, I was considering the implications of what the prelate was saying, sometimes I frown unnecessarily, he replied.

I promise you, Mr. President, this man does indeed smile, especially when he listens to Makam, hes a very good dancer you know, chortled Cahit waggling his thick pointer finger a little bit.

Ah yes, smiled the shah turning slightly red, Now, its Mr. Rideveld is it not? Asked the Shah looking at the Woolusyan Secretary of War[/quote]

"Yes, this is Rideveld, he is here to present you with one of the gifts infact we have prepared for your nation, actually. Rdeveld. If you would."

Rideveld stands up and pulls a radio and says something, then points up to the glass roof of the diplomatic reception room, a few seconds later the sky erupts with a roar as a F-222 "Eevee" that had been holding position above the white mansion swoops down before aggressively pulling up and flying above the captiol building nearby.

Rideveld begins to speak, "The president would like to increase military cooperation among our countries, and therefore we have decided to gift you 4 of our F-222 'Eevee' Attack Aircraft, although it can double as a tactical and strategic bomber if the situation necessitates it. The frames themselves are a bit on the older side, all produced during the 80s. But they are freshly refurbished. Spare parts for the aircraft will also be provided free of cost if needed. We only ask that you do not sell them and return to them to us if you wish to decommission them."
